SPEC_LINES.extraction_note: Final DOC-C §4.2 GET /api/session/me route contract; raw python-docx paragraph indexes include empty paragraphs.

EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Only OWNER, OPERATOR, or AUDITOR authenticated sessions may receive the canonical successful GET /api/session/me response.
A successful response role must be one of OWNER, OPERATOR, or AUDITOR.
Backend enforcement must prevent a broader persisted Role value from escaping through this route as a successful canonical response.
FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR: Return HTTP 200 for a SYSTEM session on the canonical GET /api/session/me route.
Emit a role value outside the final DOC-C response union.
Rely on UI hiding or TypeScript surface typing instead of backend authorization enforcement.

EVIDENCE.observed: handleSessionMe validates session existence/revocation/expiry/device/user binding, then returns session.role without enforcing the final DOC-C route role set. Prisma Session.role includes SYSTEM and verify-otac persists the durable User.role into Session.role. runApiHandler adds no RBAC gate.
